description: Shared Renovate preset for the gmicklem InterMine/BlueGenes forks (docs/DEPENDENCY-MAINTENANCE.md in intermine-planning). Repositories extend it with: {"extends": ["local>gmicklem/renovate-config"]}

packageRules.description: Our own artefacts are released, never bumped by the bot
reagent stays at 1.2.0 until decision 0007 is lifted (keystroke loss under React 18)
bootstrap 3 is end of life; replacing it is a project, not a bump
GitHub Actions versions: automerge when the repository's checks pass
Patch releases of anything: automerge when checks pass (Renovate never automerges a PR with no checks)
npm devDependencies, minor and patch: automerge when checks pass
Clojure libraries grouped into one PR per schedule run
Majors: opened only after approval from the dependency dashboard, labelled, never automerged
Base images (Postgres, Solr, Tomcat, Temurin) are deployment decisions
